title: HIGH SCHOOL SOCCER: Lady Panthers win 4-2 over Tyler; Panthers, Lions tie 0-0 | Sports | lufkindailynews.com
text:
Lufkin’s girls soccer team took a 4-2 home win over Tyler on Wednesday night at Jase Magers Field.
The Lady Panthers (6-4, 2-3) got goals from Giselle Gonzalez, Mia Veliz, Itzel Orta and Olivia Loyola in the win.
Lufkin’s girls soccer team took a 4-2 home win over Tyler on Wednesday night at Jase Magers Field.
The Lady Panthers (6-4, 2-3) got goals from Giselle Gonzalez, Mia Veliz, Itzel Orta and Olivia Loyola in the win.
The Lady Panthers will play in Hallsville on Friday.
The Panthers’ soccer team fought to a 0-0 tie with the Lions in Tyler Wednesday night.
The Panthers (6-2-3, 3-0-1) will host Hallsville on Friday.
